_: Quality metrics: lower is better. Written only by `ai:quality record` (never raises) and `ai:quality accept --reason` (raises, and says why below). Do not edit by hand.

packages.without-tests.sees: packages under packages/ that have PHP in src/ and no *Test.php under tests/
packages.without-tests.blind: how well a package is tested: one trivial test takes a package off the list

requests.duplicate-queries.sees: per GET route without path parameters: SQL statements repeated with identical SQL and bindings within one request, read from a real traced request to the running server
requests.duplicate-queries.blind: routes with path parameters or behind authentication beyond their refusal, POST flows, repetition that differs only in bindings (an N+1 over distinct ids), and redacted bindings that differ in value but mask the same

requests.query-shapes.sees: per GET route without path parameters: distinct SQL shapes (whitespace collapsed, IN lists folded) in one traced request
requests.query-shapes.blind: how expensive each shape is, and how often it runs — a slow shape counts as one, and so does a shape run a hundred times

requests.repeated-statements.sees: per GET route without path parameters: re-executions of one SQL shape with different bindings in a single request (the N+1 pattern), read from a real traced request
requests.repeated-statements.blind: which repetitions are necessary; it grows with the rows a page iterates, so it is only comparable where the data is (the demo seeds are fixed, a production database is not)

tests.skip-calls.sees: markTestSkipped( / markTestIncomplete( calls in packages/*/tests and src/modules/*/tests, per package or module
tests.skip-calls.blind: whether a skip actually fires at runtime, and skips expressed as #[Requires*] attributes or early returns

deliberate.reason: QualityLedgerGateTest skips in a consumer project, where no ledger exists to check; a pass there would claim a gate that never ran

ssr 8685814 site head: every rendered HTML page now reads the site's typed head values (platform_settings, module site_head, tenant-scoped) - one indexed SELECT, ~0.6ms, +1 shape on each of 139 HTML routes (44->183). Lazy: JSON/feed requests read nothing (verified on /demo/api/active-version with Accept: application/json). Removing it needs a per-tenant worker cache with cross-worker invalidation on site:head writes - not built; revisit if page query budgets tighten.

GET /demo/rendering/reactive-ai 2 -> 3 shapes, on review of demo 1e6a81b: one whereIn over all four statuses loaded and hydrated every completed task (history only grows) on each render. Now live statuses (running/pending/failed, few by nature) in one query, and completed only as a LIMIT 1 fallback - a bounded read for one extra shape.

New page GET /replication-demo (src/modules/ReplicationDemo, multi-master replication demo): one SELECT listing the notes. Recorded by hand for this one route: a workspace re-measure flaps other routes between 0 and 1 (one shared shape runs only sometimes inside the traced request), and taking that lucky low reading as the baseline would fail the release clone.

Demo API routes now read a page's categories and reviews in one query each (products + categories + reviews IN) instead of one per product; /playground gained the dashboard widgets (countByDay + count); the UI Playground buttons page gained the live-ping island (pings). No route repeats a statement (duplicate-queries 0).

The release clone reads the tenant platform_settings row on this page (one SELECT, one shape); the workspace serves it without that read. The same settings read was 1 shape on most routes in the 2026-09-24 baseline. Recorded so the clone does not report it as a regression.

platform-ui collab race harness (2 helpers): it registers a PHP SQL function to stage a real write race; the ultimate stack smoke's PHP gets pdo_sqlite from Swoole, which can register none, so the test skips there instead of failing.
